verdict.rationale: Supabase publishes a Management API with a live OpenAPI 3.0 spec covering organizations, projects, branches and configuration. Its MCP server and CLI expose broad project operations (SQL, migrations, Edge Function deploys, branching, logs, storage config), and the auto-generated REST/GraphQL APIs cover the data plane. Advisors are explicitly documented as available identically in Studio, MCP, CLI and the Management API, and Cron jobs can be created via SQL or the Dashboard. missing for 10: an explicit vendor statement or audit of full UI-to-API parity (some features, like the dashboard AI Assistant and Studio log inspection, are documented primarily as UI flows), independent hands-on corroboration that every dashboard action is API-reachable.
